heading.en: From communes to factories of the world

hook.en: In 1958 Chinese villagers were melting pots and pans in backyard furnaces to make steel. Fifty years later China was a giant of world manufacturing. What changed?
hook.kn: 1958ರಲ್ಲಿ ಚೀನಾದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗರು ಹಿತ್ತಲಿನ ಕುಲುಮೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಕ್ಕು ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ಐವತ್ತು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರ ಚೀನಾ ವಿಶ್ವ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯ ದೈತ್ಯವಾಯಿತು. ಏನು ಬದಲಾಯಿತು?

objectives.en: Describe the Great Leap Forward and the commune system

narration.en: In 1958 Chinese villagers were melting pots and pans in backyard furnaces to make steel. Fifty years later China was a giant of world manufacturing. What changed?
narration.kn: 1958ರಲ್ಲಿ ಚೀನಾದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗರು ಹಿತ್ತಲಿನ ಕುಲುಮೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಕ್ಕು ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ಐವತ್ತು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರ ಚೀನಾ ವಿಶ್ವ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯ ದೈತ್ಯವಾಯಿತು. ಏನು ಬದಲಾಯಿತು?

body.en: After the People's Republic of China was established in 1949 under one-party rule, all critical sectors of the economy, enterprises and land were brought under government ownership and control. The Great Leap Forward campaign, launched in 1958, aimed at industrialising the country on a massive scale; people were encouraged to set up industries in their backyards. In rural areas communes were started, in which people collectively cultivated lands; in 1958 there were 26,000 communes covering almost all the farm population. The GLF ran into problems: a severe drought killed about 30 million people, and when Russia had conflicts with China it withdrew its professionals. In 1965 Mao introduced the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution (1966–76), under which students and professionals were sent to work and learn from the countryside.

narration.en: After 1949 the Chinese state owned all key sectors and land. The Great Leap Forward of 1958 pushed backyard industries and collective farming in communes, and the Cultural Revolution of 1966 to 1976 sent students and professionals to the countryside.
narration.kn: 1949ರ ನಂತರ ಚೀನಾ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಲಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವಾಧೀನಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿತು. 1958ರ ಮಹಾ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ ಹಿತ್ತಲ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಮ್ಯೂನ್ ಕೃಷಿ ತಂದಿತು; 1966-76ರ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿತು.

narration.en: Let us trace China's path on a flowchart.

say.en: Let us draw China's journey as a flowchart from 1949.
In 1958 came the Great Leap Forward: backyard industries, and communes in which people farmed land collectively.
From 1966 to 1976 the Cultural Revolution sent students and professionals to work in the countryside.
In 1978 China began reforms: household plots, private and village enterprises, dual pricing and Special Economic Zones.
Dual pricing: sell a fixed quota at the government price, and the rest at the market price.

body.en: Since 1978 China introduced reforms in phases. In the initial phase, reforms covered agriculture, foreign trade and investment: commune lands were divided into small plots allocated to individual households for use, not ownership, and households could keep the income left after paying taxes. In the later phase, reforms reached industry: private firms and township and village enterprises, owned and operated by local collectives, were allowed to produce goods, and state-owned enterprises had to face competition. Under dual pricing, farmers and industrial units bought and sold fixed quantities at government prices and the rest at market prices. Special Economic Zones were set up to attract foreign investors.

points.en: Household plots for use, not ownership
Private firms and township and village enterprises
Dual pricing and Special Economic Zones

narration.en: China's 1978 reforms gave farm plots to households, let private and village enterprises compete with state firms, used dual pricing for a gradual move to markets, and opened Special Economic Zones for foreign investors.
narration.kn: 1978ರ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ನಿವೇಶನ ನೀಡಿದವು, ಖಾಸಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಮ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಅವಕಾಶ ನೀಡಿದವು, ದ್ವಿ ಬೆಲೆ ನೀತಿ ತಂದವು ಮತ್ತು ವಿದೇಶಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆಗಾಗಿ ವಿಶೇಷ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ವಲಯಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆದವು.

caption.en: A farmer grows Q quintals. A share f per cent must be sold to the government at price G; the rest is sold in the market at price M.

narration.en: Change the quota and the two prices to see how dual pricing affected a Chinese farmer's income.

tryThis.en: Lower the quota share. Why did this give farmers an incentive to produce more?
What happens to income if the market price falls to the government price?

problem.en: Under dual pricing, a Chinese farmer grows 100 quintals of rice. Taking prices in rupees for ease, he must sell 60 quintals to the government at ₹1,200 per quintal and may sell the rest at the market price of ₹1,800. Find his total income and average price.

answer.en: Total income ₹1,44,000; average price ₹1,440 per quintal. Every extra quintal earns the market price, an incentive to produce more.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Under dual pricing, a Chinese farmer grows 100 quintals of rice. Taking prices in rupees for ease, he must sell 60 quintals to the government at ₹1,200 per quintal and may sell the rest at the market price of ₹1,800. Find his total income and average price.

body.en: GLF in 1958, Cultural Revolution from 1966 to 1976, reforms in 1978: each a step after the last.

narration.en: Leap at fifty-eight, storm from sixty-six to seventy-six, reform at seventy-eight.

points.en: 1958 Great Leap Forward: backyard industries and communes with collective farming.
points.kn: 1958ರ ಮಹಾ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ: ಹಿತ್ತಲ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಕೃಷಿಯ ಕಮ್ಯೂನ್‌ಗಳು.

points.en: 1966–76 Cultural Revolution: students and professionals sent to the countryside.
points.kn: 1966-76 ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ: ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೃತ್ತಿಪರರನ್ನು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.

points.en: 1978 reforms: household plots, township and village enterprises, dual pricing, SEZs.
points.kn: 1978ರ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು: ಕುಟುಂಬ ನಿವೇಶನ, ಗ್ರಾಮ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು, ದ್ವಿ ಬೆಲೆ, ವಿಶೇಷ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ವಲಯಗಳು.

homework.en: Explain the Great Leap Forward and the reasons for its failure.

narration.en: Recap. 1958 Great Leap Forward: backyard industries and communes with collective farming. 1966–76 Cultural Revolution: students and professionals sent to the countryside. 1978 reforms: household plots, township and village enterprises, dual pricing, SEZs.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. 1958ರ ಮಹಾ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ: ಹಿತ್ತಲ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಕೃಷಿಯ ಕಮ್ಯೂನ್‌ಗಳು. 1966-76 ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿ: ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೃತ್ತಿಪರರನ್ನು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಯಿತು. 1978ರ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು: ಕುಟುಂಬ ನಿವೇಶನ, ಗ್ರಾಮ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು, ದ್ವಿ ಬೆಲೆ, ವಿಶೇಷ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ವಲಯಗಳು.
